units.rationale: The produced key local-aggregate-staged is the staged inbox corpus, and its dependsOnTags [app.session, fixture.corpus, lane.instance] are the ones it actually depends on rather than the ones a consumer disturbs: TestCommandChannel's resetState removes library references, folders and enchron./server-certificate-fingerprint. defaults but never touches inboxURL, so library.contents is correctly absent and confirmed-batch-deletion can reset at call 01 and still import the staged files at calls 02-04. All seven fixtureIDs resolve in Tests/Fixtures/fixture-registry.json and media.stage-fixture@2 requires both fixtureID and sourceRoot, so no optional field is indexed unconditionally. Setup is idempotent - harness.ensure-session@1 always halts and relaunches the runner (interactive_visionpro_ui.ensure_session) rather than reusing a live one, and the transcript digest sidekick_runner.py:501-510 computes over every call receipt gives the handle a fingerprint that moves whenever any staged receipt does.

The credential path is concrete and machine-only: call 01's host.preflight@1 webdav-regression writes DEFAULT_RUNTIME_ROOT/runtime.json at mode 0o600 with the keys address, user and password (regression_remote_source.py:1099-1110), which is exactly the file and the three textJSONKeys calls 17-19 name, and accessibility.type@2's handler refuses anything that is not an owner-only 0600 regular file. Re-running is deterministic because call 04's resetState deletes every server-certificate-fingerprint. default, so the FileBrowsing-CertificateTrust-trust prompt of call 21 reappears on every attempt rather than only the first, and the 以后 dismissal at call 22 is the documented route in references/product.md:66 driven by the agent, not a human. dependsOnTags covers everything the produced state rests on - library.contents for the three imports, source.connection, source.session and certificate.trust for the WebDAV source, fixture.corpus, app.session and lane.instance - with presentation.state and source.webdav merely conservative; every identifier used resolves against Config/reachability_operation_inventory.json.

The single host.preflight@1 call is a registered route: system-import-fixtures is in the check choice set at regression_operation_adapter.py:2833, the handler refuses any lane but simulator, runs regression_system_import.py ensure, validates the returned typed runtime identity against the on-disk runtime file, then enlarges the Device Hub to a fit canvas of at least 1200 px and asserts that binding. No human runtime actor is needed: the runtime records photosPicker.authorizationMode as system-picker-no-library-authorization (regression_system_import.py:497), so the PhotosPicker route requires no library permission dialog, and validate_runtime rejects any other mode. dependsOnTags [fixture.corpus, input.device-hub, lane.instance, system.permission] cover the seeded provider file and photo asset, the enlarged canvas and the lane; the fixture digest the consuming rubrics name resolves to generated-sdr-avc-bframe-multiaudio-avsync-30s-v1 in the registry, and validate_runtime binds environmentIdentity to a digest of its own facts so a drifted seed cannot pass as fresh.

The two storage.clear@1 calls are executable and correctly ordered: target is a closed choice set and container-index-cache and playback-progress map to Settings-action-clear-container-index-cache and Settings-action-clear-progress, driven through the real Navigation-Ornament-tab-settings route, and they run at calls 11-12 before call 13 returns the browser to the files tab, so the Settings detour is undone inside the Preparation. Its produced state depends on cache.state and viewing.state, both listed, and every operation that can advance viewing.progress (harness.reset-product-state@2 and storage.clear@1) advances viewing.state too, so omitting viewing.progress leaves no staleness window. The WebDAV half is identical to the presentation Preparation and rests on the same 0600 runtime.json and the certificate-fingerprint defaults that call 04's resetState clears, which is what makes call 20's trust tap reproducible on retry.

controlsAutoHideSeconds 25 really reaches the app rather than being silently dropped: _harness_ensure_session_1 forwards it as TEST_RUNNER_ENCHRON_CONTROLS_AUTO_HIDE_SECONDS, which is the only name xcodebuild passes into the runner process (docs/UI_TEST_HARNESS_CONSTRAINTS.md line on TEST_RUNNER_ENCHRON_*), _controller merges it into the subprocess environment, and InteractiveDeviceUITests.swift:23-30 copies every ENCHRON_ name out of its own process into launchEnvironment after the hardcoded 300, so the override wins. ensure_session halts and relaunches the runner unconditionally, so the value cannot be lost to a reused session, and the setting's dependencies are covered by lane.instance, app.session and settings.state in dependsOnTags. input.device-hub-prepare@1 is simulator-only and this Preparation is simulator-lane; the staged and imported 120 s fixture resolves in the registry, and library.contents and input.device-hub are both snapshotted.
